text.tspan: I'm a full-stack and mobile developer focused on building production-ready products for web
and mobile. My stack is React, React Native with Expo, Node.js, Express and MongoDB, and I
like owning a feature from schema to screen.
My approach is simple: learn by building, debug by breaking.
Open to collaborations and interesting problems. Reach me at shivam10yadav05@gmail.com.
